projects.name: New Castle County Industrial Pad Development
projects.owner: Diamond State Port Corp. / Enstructure (Port Wilmington)
projects.description: Phase 1 of $669M container terminal expansion at Edgemoor to quadruple Port of Wilmington container capacity. Early construction began June 1, 2026 after $110M additional state funding approved. Industrial pad and flex space development activity in New Castle County tied to I-95 corridor logistics demand and port-adjacent industrial growth.
key_specs: Frees existing port for military/ag cargo
projects.open_for: Early site prep active. Marine and port infrastructure specs. Site planning. Early industrial infrastructure specs.

projects.name: Middletown Exchange Phase I
projects.description: St. John Properties' Delaware market entry: 75-acre Middletown Exchange with 225,000 SF commercial and 450 homes. Phase I two flex/R&D buildings totaling 96,000 SF; spring 2026 groundbreaking.
projects.open_for: Phase I underway. Flex/R&D building systems and site specs.
